fire: The bride and groom stood together on a raised dais at the front of the hall.
Strong winds slowly reshaped every dune along the desert road.
Fishermen still sail an old wooden dhow out of the harbour each morning.
The angler landed a small dace from the shallow end of the stream.
We rowed a little dory across the bay to the lighthouse.
Посреди поля рос огромный старый дуб с густой кроной.
Летом бабушка всегда покупала сладкую дыню на базаре.
The speaker climbed onto the dais and waited for silence.
